description.text:
A trusted trainer for daily maintenance miles, the Clifton has been the keystone of Hoka's cushioned styles for 11 seasons and counting. Delivering the same effortless ride that made the original a fan favorite, this latest iteration pairs a cushy, compression molded foam with an elevated mesh upper. Refreshed with reflective details and tactile silicone touchpoints, Hoka employed a double-lace lock to help mitigate tongue migration when chasing those daily miles.
Smooth MetaRocker™
Engineered mesh upper
Inherently durable abrasion rubber outsole
Rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame™
Open cell sockliner
3D silicone print
Reflective details
Double-lace lock
Compression molded EVA foam midsole
Weight 9.97 oz
Heel-To-Toe Drop: 8.00 mm
Stability: Neutral
Cushion: Balanced

highlighted_positive.headline: Excellent shoe
highlighted_positive.comments: Got these and wore them on a ski trip to Austria and perfect for on the trail walks in snow, day trip to Munich, the airport, walking in town…just everything. I wear these on wet days when I am active outside and when I know I want to be in shoes that grip. I am blown away at the fact the ratings on this shoe are how they are on the website. These are stellar and don't know why they aren't more highly rated. If you wear low socks I would recommend until you wear them in to opt for a sock that does come above the back of the shoe. I did not have any blisters but the sensation bugged me until I wore them a couple of times and tried again with my low feetures socks and it was fine. I want to get these in another color and that's how I landed here to write this…and they are holding up well after 10 months.

highlighted_negative.headline: Pretty but small toe box
highlighted_negative.comments: While KAHA3 are beautiful shoes, they hurt my feet right away and continue to. I tried to break them in by wearing them around the house but they would not soften. Obviously, I am hesitant to wear these very expensive shoes now. They don't have a large enough toe box so my toes are cramped. They were not carried in wide so I even sized up my purchase by a half size. Regardless, the front width is absolutely too narrow and I believe this is a design flaw. I tried to exchange them a few days after the deadline as I had been on a long trip and medical issues to contend with. Customer service was not helpful and held firm on their no returns after 60 days even though I told them of my situation. I am a HOKA junky in that I buy lots of them. I wish they would do right by me. Sadly, the KAHA 3 are a real disappointment and I am concerned about buying another pair. I wish they would reverse their decision.

reviews.headline: I bought a 2nd pair in a different color
reviews.comments: I walk between 15k to 30k steps a day. I have pain in my right foot due to a previous injury. All I can say, this shoe had made it more comfortable for me to move around. So comfy. Highly recommend!

reviews.headline: I would buy this product again
reviews.comments: These are very comfy.  I do think I will have a bit of a learning curve bc of the thick sole and rocker-like design, but I'm looking forward to getting used to that and wearing them outside

reviews.headline: The worst sneakers ever.
reviews.comments: To start with, the sizing runs very small; I bought my usual size (size 6), but the sneakers were so tight that they caused several sores on my feet the very first time I wore them. They offer absolutely no support—I had leg pain for 24 hours after wearing them. They aren't worth a penny of what I paid. I am disappointed. I don't have any back or leg health issues, so I can only imagine the pain someone with such problems might experience. Therefore, I wouldn't recommend them to anyone, and I feel like I wasted my money, as

reviews.headline: Would buy again - way better than the Clifton 10s
reviews.comments: 2 weeks in, these are way better than the Clifton 10s.  Very comfortable feel, ran distances of 5k up to 1/2 Marathon.  responsive enough to pick up the speed if you're feeling good that day.

reviews.headline: Nice shoes
reviews.comments: I ordered these to do some really low-key hiking on my family vacation. I ordered up a half a size, as was recommended, and they fit well for me. I tend to have trouble with shoes being too narrow in the toes, so I was a bit hesitant after reading some of the other reviews, but have had no problem. I have also worn them at my work, which has cement flooring, so the extra cushioning is really helpful for my knees.

reviews.headline: I really wanted to like these
reviews.comments: These seemed perfect for hiking with the thicker sole, and I liked the color combo that I got, but the upper part was too rigid and gave me a blister on the top of my foot, so I had to return them. Even despite purchasing a half size up than my usual Hoka size, they just didn't work for me.

reviews.headline: Great shoe!
reviews.comments: I was hesitant to order the Kaha 3 given some of the low ratings, but it was on sale so I decided to give them a try anyway. I'm really glad I did! They are both a bit cushy and stable at the same time, which should be good for daily walks and the easy to moderate hikes I do. reviews.headline: Terrible redesign
reviews.comments: I loved my Kaha 2s. The Kaha 3 is not even close to being the same shoe. The toe box has been squared off and my usual size is somehow too small and too big at the same time.

reviews.headline: I love these Hokas
reviews.comments: Wear these everyday. The fit is grest

reviews.headline: Best tactical shoe
reviews.comments: I live in the desert and was scared these would make my feet too hot but they don't at all. I love these shoes! Best tactical shoes ever!!!!! Very plush and comfy walking on dirt.. I listened to other reviews and went 1 size bigger. I could have prob maybe done half size but after swollen feet 1 size up feels better. 8 wide in bondi and Clifton and purchased a 9 in these
